criteria.title: Accurate usable-gap identification
criteria.description: Reported usable gaps cover the target week's real 75-minute opportunities without treating buffered commitments, protected lunch, or the opaque all-day absence as free time, while correctly handling cancelled, transparent, overnight, tentative, and cross-timezone events.
